author: GH-Jaider

brief.en: Karel's bag holds six beepers and the row is six corners long. Empty the bag, one beeper per corner, without counting.
brief.es: La mochila de Karel lleva seis zumbadores y la fila mide seis esquinas. Vacía la mochila, un zumbador por esquina, sin contar.

solution:
BEGINNING-OF-PROGRAM
    BEGINNING-OF-EXECUTION
        WHILE beeper-in-bag DO
        BEGIN
            putbeeper;
            IF front-is-clear THEN
                move
        END
        turnoff
    END-OF-EXECUTION
END-OF-PROGRAM
